decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The erection of a single storey rear extension to replace the existing conservatory to the house, as shown on drawings numbered BA-101 and BA-102, received 10th November 2006, is recommended for approval as the size, position and style of the extensions would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing building, the amenity of neighbouring properties or would detract from the character of the area. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of a single storey extension to replace the existing conservatory to the house
